subject: Reconnect: pilot timeline, ops questions, and VPC vs Dedicated
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@fincloud.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + suggested pilot options

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet earlier today, and thanks for walking through FinCloud's latency and compliance constraints. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we heard:
- Goal: embed low-latency text generation into the search experience (95th pct latency target ~120ms per request)
- Data residency & auditability are important for Q1 procurement (SOC 2 + basic audit logs required)
- Expected pilot scope: 500k tokens over 2–3 weeks, up to 5 concurrent users, controlled dataset for quality checks

Recommended approach:
- Option A — Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity): fastest onboarding, predictable throughput, simpler procurement. Good if you need throughput guarantees without managing network setup.
- Option B — Redwood Private (VPC): keeps data in your VPC, integrates with your KMS, and provides stronger isolation for compliance. Slightly longer lead time for networking & IP whitelists.

Attachments: pilot_scope.pdf (proposed pilot plan + success metrics), redwood_vpc_one-pager.pdf (what VPC deployment includes).

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm which deployment you prefer (Dedicated vs VPC) so we can estimate timeline and draft a statement of work.
2) If VPC: share a primary network contact and any required IP ranges.
3) Tentative pilot window: Dec 13–31. If that works, I’ll lock engineering availability with Marissa.

If helpful I can also share a quick pricing range for a pilot and potential full production reserve.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

— Logan
Logan Wright | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha —

Quick nudge in case my last note got buried — are you still targeting the Dec 13 pilot start? If priorities shifted, totally fine — just want to make sure we either reserve Marissa's slot or free it up.

To answer your earlier questions at a high level (we can put numbers in a formal quote):
- Pilot pricing (estimated): Dedicated pilot typically $6–10k for the 2–3 week window; VPC pilot adds networking and onboarding (typically +$4–6k) depending on complexity.
- Compliance: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II; we can share the report under an NDA.
- VPC lead time: 2–4 weeks on average (network + KMS + IP allowlisting). If you have an internal network engineer we can speed this up.

I also dropped a mini-template for the pilot schedule in this Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPilotTemplate

If you prefer, I can set up a 20-min follow-up with Marissa to run the technical checklist. Would next Tue/Wed morning PST work?

— Logan
